status: Descriptive pilot complete; predictive study not executed.
question: Do previous-race sectional measurements improve future race-outcome probability forecasts beyond information already in market prices?
scope_for_next_data_audit: Consecutive Kempton Polytrack Class 4 six-furlong handicaps in a declared time window. Include every starter, record non-runners separately, and publish missingness. Fix the window before inspecting outcomes.
hypotheses: Previous-race closing speed may add information when conditioned on whole-race speed, course par and early pace.
The effect may disappear after including market prices and rating-at-race.

baseline.interpretation: Normalised market-price benchmark, not established true probability.
baseline.required_snapshot: A fixed timestamp before each target race, preserving the runners known at that timestamp. Define treatment of later withdrawals and any subsequent forecast revision in advance; do not insert the final starter set retrospectively. SP may be reported separately as a later benchmark, never substituted for an earlier available price.

data_requirements: Stable horse/race identifiers and source/retrieval timestamps.
Previous starts only: sectionals, elapsed time, distance, surface, class, going and carried weight.
Separate official rating-at-race, current rating and race performance figure; require historical availability evidence for predictive inputs.
Provider model version/publication dates for pars, or exclude pars from claims requiring strict historical availability.
All target-race outcomes kept separate from inputs; missing values kept missing.
validation: Split chronologically by whole races; never split runners within a race across train and test.
Fit transformations, feature choices and calibration on the training period only.
Compare market-only and market-plus-performance forecasts with race-level log loss, Brier score and calibration.
Retain an untouched later period; report uncertainty accounting for common meetings and repeated horses.
Exclude these already inspected pilot races from claims about an untouched test set.
A subsequent prospective, timestamped prediction record is needed to assess whether results persist.
economic_evidence_requirements: No ROI estimate is supported by this pilot. Any later economic analysis additionally needs actual available prices/stakes, commissions, non-runner reductions, liquidity, execution timing and applicable fees.
scope_limits: This folder contains public-data research and offline calculations only. It does not access betting accounts, submit wagers or produce live staking instructions.
